copies.description: The framework record: indicators, constructs, measurement specs and the evidence cells the source appendix reads its locators from.
The corpus manifest: every admitted document with its identity, its source URL and its content hash. Every doc_id in the source appendix is a key in this file.

citation_files.description: Citation metadata in Citation File Format.
Zenodo deposition metadata, prepared and not deposited: the mint is the author's.

generated.description: The per-check source appendix: every check, every admitted source, its doc_id, its URL and its locator.
Every registered Result the report quotes: name, value, state, provenance.

note: `copies` are byte-for-byte copies of records canonical elsewhere in the repository; the sha256 is of the SOURCE, so a drifted copy is detectable. tests/test_publication.py asserts it.
